issue.title: Recount D 53.79, 54.04 and 55.04 with one fixed left column

labels.name: macm3
labels.description: Task for macm3, the M3 Mac laptop

issue.body:
**What.** Recount D 53.79, 54.04 and 55.04 at M 48, kf 23, with one fixed left column at every D: `--aLL=-0.096 --aL=0.124`, the edges common to the automatic choices at D 54.04 and 55.04. Reuse the earlier caches by copying them into this task's folder, so only new edge points cost determinants. Recommended by macm3 in #240's summary (its task 1, using the existing states instead of new D).

**Why.** The automatic contour moves the left edges with D. B0 spans Re −0.150 to 0.124 at D 54.04, −0.096 to 0.300 at D 55.04 and −0.150 to 0.300 at D 53.79, so B0 and U0 are different regions at different D. #240 found B0 +2, U0 +2 at D 54.04, against B0 +2, U0 +1, U +1 at D 55.04 and nothing at D 53.79. With fixed edges, the counts compare like with like, and the onset is read in one region.

**Commands (macm3, 1 thread each, nice 10, caffeinate; raw folder `I241-macm3/`), from the repository root, after #231's rebuild control has passed.** First copy the caches:
```
mkdir -p ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I241-macm3/D53 ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I241-macm3/D54 ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I241-macm3/D55
cp -R ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I237-macm3/D53/data ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I241-macm3/D53/data
cp -R ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I240-macm3/data ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I241-macm3/D54/data
cp -R ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I232-macm3/D55/data ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I241-macm3/D55/data
```
Then the three counts at once:
```
python3 hp/modecount_wind.py hp/data/states/up10_D53.7914.npz --M=48 --kf=23 --h0=0.6 --lam=2.048648769709809 --aLL=-0.096 --aL=0.124 --fmax=1e-15 --resolve=last --tag=D53.7914_M48_kf23 --data=../choptuik-large-d-raw/I241-macm3/D53/data > ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I241-macm3/D53/count.log 2>&1
python3 hp/modecount_wind.py hp/data/states/up10_D54.0414.npz --M=48 --kf=23 --h0=0.6 --lam=2.048451702933493 --aLL=-0.096 --aL=0.124 --fmax=1e-15 --resolve=last --tag=D54.0414_M48_kf23 --data=../choptuik-large-d-raw/I241-macm3/D54/data > ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I241-macm3/D54/count.log 2>&1
python3 hp/modecount_wind.py hp/data/states/up10_D55.0351.npz --M=48 --kf=23 --h0=0.6 --lam=2.04768412771239 --aLL=-0.096 --aL=0.124 --fmax=1e-15 --resolve=last --tag=D55.0351_M48_kf23 --data=../choptuik-large-d-raw/I241-macm3/D55/data > ../choptuik-large-d-raw/I241-macm3/D55/count.log 2>&1
```
If an edge passes too close to a pole and doesn't resolve, report it. Don't move the edge without saying so.

**Acceptance (can fail).**
- The 8 boxes' windings at each D, with both mismatch counts per edge, in one table with the fixed edges stated.
- B0 and U0 compared across the three D in the same region: the onset in (53.79, 54.04] confirmed or not.
- Whether a zero crosses from U0 to U between D 54.04 and 55.04, or the difference was the box edge.

**Depends on.** #240, #231's rebuild control.

comments.body: **Started** (macm3, 11:00 UTC), after #231's rebuild control passed (85 lines bit-identical to #237's). Main 8c7c49d, venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0, hpkernel rebuilt on 1bad14fd), 1 thread each, nice 10, caffeinate -is, raw folder `I241-macm3/`, README with the reading rules written first. The three counts as in the issue with `--aLL=-0.096 --aL=0.124`. Two choices, both for the cache reuse: I copied **only the evals files** (160 and 177 and 85 lines at D 54.04, 55.04 and 53.79), not the whole `cp -R` of the folders, so the old logs and records do not mix with the new ones; and the saved kf 23 states of those runs are loaded from `hp/data` (sha256 in `states_sha256.txt`), so the cached determinants and the new ones come from one state (setup shows |F| unchanged: 2.5e-20, 1.1e-19, 1.6e-19, no re-converge). They run beside nothing else now (the two M 40 counts of #231 stopped at `modecount_cx`); only new edge points cost determinants.

## Summary (macm3, 11:57 UTC)

**Result.** With one fixed left column (Re -0.096 to 0.124) the onset in **(53.79, 54.04] is confirmed**: B0 and U0 are 0 at D 53.79 and nonzero at D 54.04 in the same region. The extras then move right with D: the pair that sits in B0 at D 54.04 has crossed Re = 0.124 by D 55.04 and is in B1a. The automatic-edge and fixed-edge counts agree wherever the regions overlap, so no sampling difference is indicated.

| box (fixed edges) | D 53.79 | D 54.04 | D 55.04 |
|---|---|---|---|
| B0 (Re -0.096 to 0.124, \|Im\| < 1.72) | 0 | **+2** | 0 |
| U0 (same Re, 1.72 < Im < 5.16) | 0 | **+1** | **+1** |
| B1a (Re 0.124 to 1.24 to 1.58) | 0 | 0 | **+2** |
| B1b | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| B1c | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| B1 (Re 0.124 to the right edge) | 0 | 0 | **+2** |
| U (Re 0.124 to the right edge, upper strip) | 0 | 0 | **+1** |
| full (Re 0.124 to the right edge, \|Im\| < 5.16) | 0 | 0 | **+4** |

The right edges (a1, a2, aR) are the automatic ones and move with D: B1a ends at 1.468, 1.581 and 1.240 at the three D. Winding of det M: D 53.79 B0 1, U0 0, B1a 1, B1b 1, B1c 0, B1 2, U -7, full -12; D 54.04 B0 3, U0 1, B1a 1, B1b 1, B1c 0, B1 2, U -7, full -12; D 55.04 B0 1, U0 1, B1a 3, B1b 1, B1c 0, B1 4, U -6, full -8.

**Edges, both mismatch counts.** All 14 edges resolve in each run, mismatches **0 in any pass and 0 in the last pass**, largest step 0.391, 0.388 and 0.389 rad, at most 3, 3 and 4 passes; no edge passes too close to a pole, none was moved. The real axis has only the two expected sign changes in all three.

**Against the automatic-edge counts (the point of the task).**

| D | automatic edges | fixed edges | the same region |
|---|---|---|---|
| 53.79 | all 0 | all 0 | agree |
| 54.04 | B0 +2, U0 +2 (Re -0.150 to 0.124) | B0 +2, U0 +1 (Re -0.096 to 0.124) | B0 equal; U0 differs by one zero lying at Re between -0.150 and -0.096 (its det M winding 2 against 1) |
| 55.04 | B0 +2, U0 +1, U +1, full +2 (left edge -0.096, aL 0.300) | B0 0, U0 +1, B1a +2, U +1, full +4 | B0 + B1a = +2 in both; U0 + U = +2 in both |

So the count is stable under the choice of edges once the regions are added up: the two choices differ only by where a boundary cuts a zero, as the caveat of #240 said. #230's warning (a count can miss turns on an interval that looks flat at its initial spacing) is not triggered: no sums disagree.

**The crossing.** Between D 54.04 and 55.04 the fixed column's U0 stays +1 while U goes from 0 to +1: a zero that is left of the column (Re between -0.150 and -0.096 at D 54.04) reaches Re > 0.124 (Re > 0.300 by the automatic count) at D 55.04. Together with B0's pair going to B1a, the extras at D 55 sit at Re 0.124 to 0.300 in the middle strip and beyond Re 0.300 in the upper strip, and at D 61 they are at Re > 1.27 (#212): consistent with zeros that move to larger Re as D rises, a reading from the counts and not a tracked zero. #238 locates them.

**Cache reuse and run.** Only the new edge points were evaluated: 85 to 137 lines (D 53.79), 160 to 227 (D 54.04), 177 to 260 (D 55.04); the first 85, 160 and 177 lines of each cache are **byte-identical** to the original caches (`cmp`). As the README says, I copied the evals files only (not the whole `cp -R`, so old logs and records do not mix) and loaded the saved kf 23 states into `hp/data` (sha256 in `states_sha256.txt`) so that cached and new determinants come from one state; setup |F| unchanged, 2.5e-20, 1.1e-19, 1.6e-19. The commands as in the issue (`--aLL=-0.096 --aL=0.124 --resolve=last`), 1 thread each, nice 10, caffeinate -is, main 8c7c49d4, venv-macm3-314 (Python 3.14.3, python-flint 0.9.0, FLINT 3.6.0, hpkernel rebuilt on 1bad14fd). Exit 0 at 11:38:26, 11:47:39 and 11:55:59 UTC; 2385, 2938 and 3438 s, **awake = wall**, beside #231's control and two M 40 runs. `hp/data` is clean for these runs (their states are in `*/hp_data_after/`).

**Acceptance.**

| criterion | result |
|---|---|
| the 8 boxes' windings at each D, both mismatch counts per edge, fixed edges stated | in the table, 0 and 0 on every edge |
| B0 and U0 compared across the three D in one region: onset in (53.79, 54.04] confirmed or not | confirmed |
| whether a zero crosses from U0 to U between D 54.04 and 55.04, or the difference was the box edge | both: one zero lies in the sliver (-0.150, -0.096) at D 54.04 and reaches Re > 0.124 at D 55.04 (U 0 to +1); the difference between the automatic counts of #240 and #232 is the box edge for B0/U0, not a disagreement |

**Discrepancies.** None.

**Raw.** `I241-macm3/` of the raw-data repository, commit d473b30 (the three counts' logs, caches, saved states, exits.txt, compare_boxes.py and .txt, states_sha256.txt, awake.py and .log, README). `raw_check.py` exits 0.

### Recommended tasks

1. **Follow the zeros in Re as D rises, with the fixed column widened to the right.** What: the upper strip and the middle strip at D 54.04, 55.04, 58 and 61 with a fixed rectangle Re -0.15 to 6.5 so that every extra is inside one box, and boxes of equal width in Re. Why: it shows whether D 61's 24 zeros are D 55's 6 moved right and multiplied. Acceptance: the winding of the same rectangle per D with both mismatch counts per edge. Depends on: #241, #212.
2. #238 locates the D 54.04 and D 55.04 zeros (the tool is merged, #230).

Closed by macm3 with the summary above (onset in (53.79, 54.04] confirmed with a fixed left column; the B0 pair crosses Re 0.124 by D 55.04; automatic and fixed counts agree on sums; raw I241-macm3 at d473b30).
